name: Graphic
signature: public abstract class Graphic : UIBehaviour, IColorTint

docs.summary: Base for every UI element that actually draws something. Owns the tint, the optional material override, and whether the element takes part in pointer hit-testing.
docs.remarks: Behaviours that produce no geometry (layout groups, [`CanvasGroup`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.UI.CanvasGroup), [`RectMask`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.UI.RectMask), [`Selectable`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.UI.Selectable)) derive from [`UIBehaviour`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.UI.UIBehaviour) directly and are never raycast targets, so a bare layout panel no longer swallows clicks meant for what is behind it.

docs.summary: The material used when no override is assigned.
The material this element draws with. Default returns the shared `DefaultUI` material.
